propositions: Unresolved code review findings raised on earlier patchsets and not re-emitted on later ones fail to reach consumers, causing silent defect loss across patchsets.
A finding is eligible for carry-forward only if it is surfaced (blocking or advisory, not dropped), has non-empty evidence, and has not already been carried (no prior standing object).

Each carried finding's state (still-present, addressed, or withdrawn) is determined by comparing the cited file's content hash against the prior review's deps map using region_gate.region_for_finding.
A carried finding's posture is clamped to at most its origin_decision bucket (from the prior surfaced state) to prevent carry-forward from raising a blocking decision.

Carried findings are injected post-Pass-1 as standing_findings workflow input via a shared memory key (session_id or change_id), merged into fresh findings whose norm_id was not re-emitted, and reach only code_review_verify_inputs, never finders.
Carry-forward is one-shot: a finding carried from patchset N to N+1 cannot be re-carried to N+2, preventing ratcheting chains and bounding maximum patchset lifetime per finding.
